sentences.en: The date and place of the meeting have been fixed.
sentences.zh: 会议的时间和地点已经确定。

sentences.en: Uncle Bob fixed my clock. It keeps good time now.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃叔叔修好了我的钟。现在它走得很准。

sentences.en: We had better do away with such a fixed idea.
sentences.zh: 我们最好摒弃这种固定的想法。
